arabic_text: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡا۟ فَقُلۡ حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُ لَاۤ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
english_meaning: But if they turn away, [O Muhammad], say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne
